## 🚨 New Hospital Programme users 📢

If you are using the model for the purposes of the New Hospital Programme, please
note that programme-specific advice, guidance and content can be found on the 
[NHP NHS Futures site](https://future.nhs.uk/system/login?nextURL=%2Fconnect%2Eti%2FNewHospitalProgrammeDigital%3Fsm%5Fnewemail%3D).
